design: Direct in-reach pickup, crossing three object shapes, two explicit loads, two tool states and two fresh layout/friction replicates: 24 confirmation attempts. A single fixed authored controller uses a declared geometry-aware grasp-position rule. Layout and friction vary jointly between the two deterministic replicates; these are not random population samples or confidence-interval estimates. Development uses one separate known layout crossed with the same two loads, three shapes and two tool states.
comparison: Within each layout and load, object mass, friction, spawn position, robot actuators and control settings are matched across all six shape/tool cells. Load pairs share the same layout and friction. Changing shape necessarily changes contact geometry and inertia; removing the mounted rake changes wrist mass/inertia as well as clearance. Tool absence is a morphology ablation, not successful tool detachment. Report shape × load × tool results separately; never present easy-object lifts as shoe-skill success.
cohort_access: The independent evaluator seals the fresh parameter cases before the final controller is frozen. Controller tuning may use development only. Do not inspect or execute fresh cases until a source freeze is recorded. After the first evaluation these cases are known regressions; rerunning them does not create new confirmation evidence.
scope: Authored direct-pickup diagnostic with privileged native observations, assumed rigid-object contact properties and pinned simulation actuators. No retrieval, learned policy, tool acquisition, deformable shoe, physical grip-capacity measurement or hardware-transfer claim. Frozen v02 retrieval results remain separate regressions and are not pooled into this study.

criteria.reference_scope: At the fixed 0.4 s native timestamp, the previous 50 ticks must each show world normal force >0.01 N and aggregate robot/tool normal force <0.01 N, with range <=1 mm on each position axis. The reference height is read from the native trace, never trusted from an event coordinate.
criteria.height_scope: Object body-origin rise >=35 mm from the verified settled reference, on every final native tick. Actual lowest collision-surface height is an additional diagnostic and does not replace the fixed criterion.
criteria.support_scope: Both finger normal forces >0.01 N; world, tool and other-robot normal forces each <0.01 N during the final 500 ms. Synthetic evidence thresholds, not calibrated hardware limits.
criteria.abort_scope: All planned attempts remain in the denominator. A recorded physical abort, short run or unsettled initialization cannot pass. Corrupt or incomplete native evidence is invalid and also cannot pass. No outcome-dependent exclusion or private retry.
